name: Verified Origin Lite
author: verifiedorigin

sections.description:
Verified Origin Lite gives WordPress website owners a free local trust intelligence snapshot, Top Trust Opportunities, business evidence previews, basic claim prompts, Lite trust history, a public Lite badge and a clearer upgrade path to Verified Origin Pro.

The Lite plugin checks basic WordPress trust markers such as HTTPS, privacy policy presence, contact route, published page depth and public website identity. It is designed to help users review basic website trust signals, site trust indicators, website credibility signals and simple website verification markers from inside WordPress.

Lite also shows clear next-step advice and includes a dedicated Upgrade to Pro page explaining Trust History, change monitoring, business evidence review, claim review guidance, content review, originality guidance and full public trust reports.

Verified Origin Lite is intentionally cautious. It does not claim to legally verify a business, prove identity, guarantee website credibility, prove content originality, or run the full Verified Origin cloud trust engine. It provides basic local review signals to support human judgement.

Use Verified Origin Lite for:

  • Basic website trust checks
  • Top 5 Trust Opportunities
  • Local WordPress trust intelligence snapshots
  • Business evidence previews
  • Basic claim detection previews
  • Simple website verification signals
  • Site trust and website credibility indicators
  • Public Lite trust badge display
  • A free starting point before upgrading to Pro

Upgrade to Verified Origin Pro for:

  • Trust History
  • Change Monitoring
  • Business Evidence Review
  • Claim Review
  • Full Public Trust Report
  • Advanced trust diagnostics
  • Content review
  • AI content review indicators
  • Originality review
  • Deeper website credibility and trust signal analysis
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/verified-origin-lite/, or install through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate Verified Origin Lite.
  3. Go to VO Lite in the WordPress admin menu.
  4. Click Run Lite Trust Check and review the Basic Trust Snapshot.
  5. Add the shortcode [verified_origin_lite_badge] where required, or enable the floating badge in settings.
sections.faq:
Does Lite run the full Verified Origin trust engine?

No. Lite runs simple local WordPress checks only. Pro unlocks the full trust review, monitoring and public reporting features.

Does the Lite badge prove that a business is verified?

No. The Lite badge is a basic website trust snapshot. It should not be presented as legal, financial, identity or business verification.

Does Lite provide official website verification?

No. Lite checks simple website verification signals such as HTTPS, contact routes, privacy policy presence and public website identity markers. It does not provide official verification, certification or legal proof.

Does Lite include AI content review?

Lite does not run the full AI content review or originality review available in Pro. Lite focuses on basic local trust markers. Pro adds deeper content review, AI-assisted writing indicators and originality guidance.

Can Lite help with website credibility checks?

Lite can help review basic website credibility signals such as contact information, privacy pages, terms/service information, published page depth and public trust badge availability. These signals should be used as guidance, not proof.

Can I hide the floating badge?

Yes. Go to VO Lite > Settings and disable the floating badge.

Can I use a shortcode instead?

Yes. Use [verified_origin_lite_badge].
